description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pallewela, Balangoda, D/S/Division, Rathnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620086 (24/0576)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a formal declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title for specific land parcels (Nos. 78, 79, and 80) in Pallewela village, including detailed ownership information, property boundaries, and registration particulars. The content focuses entirely on land property matters without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other non-land related administrative matters.
